name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set a cable pulley to its lowest position and stand side-on to it, holding the handle in the hand furthest from the machine.
Keeping a slight bend in the elbow, raise the arm out to the side until it is level with the shoulder.
Lower under control and repeat. Switch sides after each set.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit in the lateral raise machine with the pads against the outside of your upper arms or forearms.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly to the start.

name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles with your elbows slightly bent, level with your shoulders.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest, squeezing the pecs.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest, then repeat.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Sit facing the pad with the handles set in front of you at shoulder height.
With a slight bend in the elbows, pull the handles out and back until your arms are in line with your shoulders.
Squeeze the rear delts, then return under control.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start level with your shoulders and sit with your back against the pad.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly to the start and repeat.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight, keeping your shoulders back against the pad.
Return slowly until your hands are just in front of your chest.

name: Seated Machine Row
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and take the handles with your arms extended.
Pull the handles toward you, driving the elbows back and squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to a full stretch and repeat.

name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand hanging straight down.
Row the dumbbells up toward your hips, keeping the chest on the pad.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Set the assistance weight, kneel or stand on the platform and take an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang. Reduce the assistance over time.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand a stride in front of a bench and rest the top of one foot on it behind you, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend the front knee to lower your body until the front thigh is about parallel with the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand. Finish the set, then switch legs.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
instructions: Sit with your upper back against the pad and the belt or bar across your hips.
Drive your hips up until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, squeezing the glutes.
Lower under control and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through the heels to lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads against the outside of your knees.
Push your legs apart as far as you comfortably can.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads against the inside of your knees and your legs open.
Squeeze your legs together.
Return slowly to the open position and repeat.

name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
instructions: Sit with the back pad supporting you, the lap pad locked over your thighs and your ankles on top of the lower pad.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Return slowly to the start and repeat.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something solid or held by a partner.
Keeping your hips straight, lower your body forward as slowly as you can, resisting with the hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands, push back lightly and pull yourself up to the start.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and slide down until your thighs are level with the floor and your knees are above your ankles.
Hold the position, keeping your back flat against the wall.
Stand up when the time is done.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with your hands about shoulder width apart and let your body hang with straight arms.
Keep the shoulders relaxed but not fully slack, and hold for the time.
Step down and rest.

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Set the pulley high and stand side-on, holding the handle with both hands at shoulder height.
Pull the handle down and across your body to the opposite hip, rotating through the torso.
Return under control. Finish the set, then switch sides.

name: Burpee
instructions: From standing, squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position, do a push-up, then jump your feet back in.
Jump straight up with your arms overhead and land softly. That is one rep.

name: Battle Ropes
instructions: Hold one end of the rope in each hand with your knees slightly bent and hips back.
Whip the ropes up and down in alternating or matching waves, keeping the waves going for the whole interval.
Rest, then repeat.

name: Swimming
instructions: Swim laps at a steady pace using any stroke.
Log the distance covered and the time it took.

name: Running, Outdoor
instructions: Run outdoors at a pace you can sustain for the distance.
Log the distance covered and the time it took.

name: Walking, Outdoor
instructions: Walk outdoors at a brisk pace.
Log the distance covered and the time it took.

name: Ski Erg
instructions: Stand facing the machine and take the handles overhead.
Pull the handles down past your hips by hinging at the hips and driving the arms down, then return to the start.
Keep a steady rhythm for the distance.

name: Cable Front Raise
instructions: Set a cable pulley low, face away from the machine and hold the handle in front of your thigh.
Raise the arm straight in front of you to shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbow.
Lower under control and repeat. Switch arms after each set.

name: Machine Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit with your upper arms on the pad and take the handles with your elbows bent.
Extend your arms until they are straight.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley, face the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Kick the strapped leg straight back, squeezing the glute at the top.
Return under control. Finish the set, then switch legs.

name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Set the pulley low with a rope attachment, face away from the machine and hold the rope between your legs.
Hinge at the hips and let the rope pull your hands back between your legs.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall, squeezing the glutes.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform and your legs straight.
Push the platform away by pointing your toes, raising your heels as high as possible.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the calves and repeat.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Set a barbell on the floor and bend over it with a flat back parallel to the floor, gripping just outside your legs.
Row the bar explosively to your lower chest.
Lower it all the way back to the floor and reset before the next rep.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Stand side-on to the end of a landmine barbell, hinge at the hips and take the end of the bar overhand with one hand.
Row the bar up toward your hip, driving the elbow back.
Lower under control. Finish the set, then switch sides.
